chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: Festival plans for 1980 and playing Berne as long as he can
summary: He cannot do all the spring festivals, but he is committed to Berne, which he helped create, and recalls his International Europeans record.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Well, now, when you get back from Europe this time, after-- you're going to go for that three month tour approximately, one of the major activities you're going to have in this country, as it's been for the last few years - you're going to tour a lot of the festivals; you'll probably be going to a lot of festivals in this country - right?
Well, in Europe too.
Well, you'll keep going back to Europe---
Yeah.
But, I mean, now the festival phenomena in this country is really spectacular - don't you thing?

Yes - there's sure a lot of them. But, uh, this year-- I'm going back to Berne and then I go to Germany and then I go to Norway and then I go to Denmark - I have a tour of Denmark; I have a little tour of Sweden; so I'm going to have to avoid---
You'll miss a lot of the festivals this year---
Over here.
Yeah.
Because I can't do them both and,
unfortunately, sometimes all these festivals fall within the May - April - June and I can't do them all; it's too many, you know.
Yeah - you can't.
Yeah.

Well, if you could do them all, in this country and if you decided to do them only in this country, you probably would not have to go back to present time Europe, but right at the / you still enjoy going back there- so,---

I'm quoted - I've already said - you know - I've signed the contract for them and I never can--- as long as I can play, I will play Berne-- and that is the last of April and a few days into June and, of course, you know, I helped create that one and, so, I'm a part of it--
Right.
And, so, no matter what happens, I'm Wild Bill Davison's Band--- Wild Bill Davison's Band is always there. But, what they've trying to do is to change my band every year.
Yeah - have different personnel.
And, of course, you knew I did that fantastic record with Europeans -- I had Wild Bill's International Europeans - or whatever we called it -
That was good - that was tremendous--
Yes - a tremendous band and, uh, I just think that, I suppose the day will come where I shall
be playing festivals.
Yeah.
If I'm able - I will play the festivals.
